linkedin:
Set `DEBUG=False`, read `SECRET_KEY` and the database from the environment, list your domain in `ALLOWED_HOSTS`.

Then deploy: `pip install`, `collectstatic`, `migrate`, and start with `gunicorn` bound to the assigned port. That's the whole job. `runserver` never touches production.

Read the full guide: https://www.kloudbean.com/blog/deploy-django-app/
